claim_scores.rationale: Creates a temp `custom_module.py`, adds its directory to `sys.path`, imports `custom_module`, instantiates `MyModule`, and saves with `save_program=True`.
First save omits `modules_to_serialize`, then removes the module from `sys.modules` and `sys.path`, and catches `ModuleNotFoundError` from `dspy.load(..., allow_pickle=True)`.
Second save uses `save(..., save_program=True, modules_to_serialize=[custom_module])`, matching the by-value serialization path described in the evidence.
After re-saving, it again removes the import path/module, successfully loads, and asserts the nested predictor signature matches the original program.
